title: Tokyo Station Chase
description: First-person chase through Tokyo Station: collect yen, buy a Shinkansen ticket and make the train before the salaryman catches you.

title: Bondi Ski
description: Tribes-style deathmatch on the real Bondi to Coogee clifftops: ski, jet and fight with discs and burst rifles. Time trials and races too.

title: Tied to the Tracks
description: Twenty questions against an evil railway baron: his robot answers your yes-or-no questions with a decision model, and the train is coming for your pet.
